details.description: Ministral 3 14B is the largest model in Mistral AI's Ministral 3 family, an edge-optimized model line released December 2, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license. It pairs a 13.5B-parameter language model with a 0.4B-parameter vision encoder for combined text and image input, and Mistral says its capabilities are comparable to its larger Mistral Small 3.2 24B model. The instruction-tuned FP8 build supports native function calling and JSON-constrained output, and Mistral's FP8 build is designed to fit on a single 24GB-VRAM GPU.
advantages: Scores 90.4% on MATH Maj@1 and an Arena Hard score of 55.1, per Mistral's instruct-model benchmark table on its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 68.5 on WildBench and 8.49 on MM MTBench (multimodal chat), per the same benchmark table.
Mistral says its capabilities are comparable to its larger Mistral Small 3.2 24B model.
Supports native function calling and JSON-constrained output, per its Hugging Face model card.
Its FP8 build is designed to fit in 24GB of VRAM, and less when further quantized, per its model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing commercial and derivative use.
disadvantages: Text and image input only; Mistral's model card does not describe audio or video input support.
use_cases: General-purpose chat and instruction-following at near-24B-class capability in a smaller footprint
Combined vision-and-text tasks such as image analysis and document understanding
Agentic applications using native function calling and JSON-constrained output
Single-GPU or edge deployment where a larger model would not fit

notes: Bud's catalog id 'ministral-3-14b-2512' does not literally match Mistral's own advertised La Plateforme API id for this model, which its docs page lists as 'ministral-14b-2512' (alias 'ministral-14b-latest'), with no '-3-' infix anywhere in that page's alias list. Treated as the same Ministral 3 14B model based on matching size (14B), the '2512'/v25.12 release wave, provider (mistral), and the fact no other Mistral model of this name and date exists. Catalog's 262,144-token input/output limits match the 256K context window stated on both Mistral's docs page and Hugging Face model card exactly, so no conflict there.
